name: ansible-role
title: Ansible role
blurb: Ansible role with defaults, variables, a template, a handler and an assert-based verification playbook

verify.name: idempotent
verify.cmd: ansible-playbook -i localhost, -e textstat_prefix=$PWD/.play/prefix tests/playbook.yml | tee .play/rerun.log | grep -q 'changed=0'

verify.name: separator-override
verify.cmd: ansible-playbook -i localhost, -e textstat_prefix=$PWD/.play/prefix -e textstat_separator='|' tests/playbook.yml >/dev/null && test "$(.play/prefix/bin/textstat .play/sample.txt)" = '2|3|17'

verify.name: columns-override
verify.cmd: ansible-playbook -i localhost, -e textstat_prefix=$PWD/.play/prefix -e textstat_columns=bytes tests/playbook.yml >/dev/null && test "$(.play/prefix/bin/textstat .play/sample.txt)" = '17'
